name: Shanghai C&D INNOSTIC Medical Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai C&D INNOSTIC Medical Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution and sale of medical devices in China. The company offers vascular intervention products, such as cardiovascular, neurovascular, and peripheral vascular interventional devices, as well as vascular stents, balloons, catheters, guidewires, coils, and vascular filters; surgical instrument, including staplers, patches, ultrasonic scalpels, and other surgical instruments; in vitro diagnostic reagents and supporting instruments; and medical equipment comprising imaging equipment and medical treatment equipment.
